goalZh: 综合用 Could I / Could you…?、说问题和价格,独立办完退房、核对账单、寄存行李和叫车
canDoZh: 能独立办退房:还房卡、核对账单、寄存行李、请前台帮忙叫车

newItems.noteZh: 酒店、手机、水电的账单都叫 bill;美国餐厅结账习惯说 check(第 4 单元)。i 是短音,结尾 l 要收住。
This is wrong. 这不对;w 不发音,读 /rɑːŋ/,结尾是后鼻音 /ŋ/。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hi. We'd like to check out, please.
lines.zh: (周四中午,退房那天)你好,我们要退房。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Here are our keys, for 604 and 514.
lines.zh: 这是我们的房卡,604 和 514 的。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: The rooms were great. But there was no hot water the first night.
lines.zh: 房间很好。不过第一晚没有热水。

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: I'm so sorry about that. Here's your bill.
lines.zh: 真是抱歉。这是你们的账单。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Hmm, this is wrong. What's this? Parking, 40 dollars?
lines.zh: 嗯,这不对。这是什么?停车费 40 美元?

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: We don't have a car. We didn't drive here.
lines.zh: 我们没有车,不是开车来的。

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry! That's not your car. Here's a new bill.
lines.zh: 哦,对不起!那不是你们的车。给您一张新的账单。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: That's OK. Could you keep our bags? We're coming back at four.
lines.zh: 没关系。能帮我们寄存一下行李吗?我们四点回来。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Could you call a car for us at four? We're going to the airport.
lines.zh: 能请您四点帮我们叫一辆车吗?我们要去机场。

lines.speaker: receptionist
lines.text: Sure, no problem. Have a safe trip home!
lines.zh: 好的,没问题。祝你们一路平安!

grammar.titleZh: 单元小结:住酒店的几种说法
grammar.bodyZh: 这个单元在酒店里用到的说法,退房时会一起用上:① 礼貌请求:Could I…? / Could you…?(Could you keep our bags?),回答 Sure. / Of course.;② 说问题:… doesn't work. / There's no hot water.;③ 道歉和回应:I'm so sorry about that. — That's OK.;④ 价格:189 dollars per night, plus tax;Does that include…?;⑤ 用过去时说住得怎么样:The rooms were great. But there was no hot water the first night.(there was 是 there is 的过去式)。提意见时语气平和:先说好的,用 but 转折前稍停一下,再说问题。发现账单不对,直接说 This is wrong.,再指出是哪一项。
